feedback.explanation: A p-value measures the probability of observing results at least as extreme as those measured, assuming the null hypothesis is true.

feedback.q: Which measure is robust to outliers?
feedback.explanation: The median is robust to outliers; the mean is heavily influenced by extreme values.

feedback.q: What does a confidence interval represent?
feedback.explanation: A 95% CI means that if we repeated the experiment many times, 95% of such intervals would contain the true parameter.

feedback.q: When is a chi-square test appropriate?
feedback.explanation: Chi-square tests compare observed vs expected frequencies in categorical data.

feedback.q: What is the Central Limit Theorem?
feedback.explanation: CLT states that sampling distributions of means approach normality as sample size grows, regardless of the population distribution.
